newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tye Soon offers 41.9 mln shares to public in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Tye Soon offers 41.9 mln shares to public in IPO.

text.p: Vehicle parts distributor Tye Soon Ltd said on Monday it was offering 41.9 million shares at Singapore $0.31 each to the public in its new share offer.
The company said in a prospectus it was offering another 17.95 million shares at S$0.31 each for placement.
Tye Soon distributes about 20,000 automotive components from over 80 brands, including Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Volkswagen, Audi, Nissan, Toyota and Mitsubishi.
It is also involved in the distribution of products including food, medical and pharmaceutical supplies.
At S$0.31, the shares are priced at a historic price earnings ratio of 10 times.

The total share offer will raise net proceeds of about S$18.7 million to be used to expand its operations in Malaysia which include a warehouse acquisition, to build two additional storeys at a Singapore warehouse, to repay loans and for working capital.
The offer is lead managed by Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia Ltd.

Tye Soon recorded a net profit of S$5.38 million on a turnover of S$130.27 million for the year ended December 31, 1996. The share offer closes on May 15 and starts trading on May 19. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703083)
